title: Collectables - Pint-Sized Slasher Masks Guide
subtitle: How to start The Slasher: Masked Truth, where the masks turn up, what each batch of masks gives you, and the rewards.

sections.title: Finding Them
sections.html:
There are 108 Pint-Sized Slasher Masks all over Appalachia. Each one is a fixed spawn, so it's always in the same place.

  • Listen for them. When you get close to a mask you hear a laughing sound. You can turn it up in Settings › Audio › Effects.
  • Track the challenge. Go to Menu › Challenges › Appalachia › (Seasonal) Collect Pint-Sized Slasher Masks and press Track.
  • Where they go. Masks go in the Misc tab of your Pip-Boy as Pint-Sized Slasher Mask.
  • They're yours only. Masks can't be dropped, traded or sold.
  • One per character. Once you pick one up, it won't respawn for that character.
  • XP. Each mask you pick up is worth a base of 400 XP.
  • Only while the event is on. The Slasher: Masked Truth is only available for the duration of The Slasher Seasonal Content.

sections.title: How to Start The Slasher: Masked Truth
sections.html:
Listen to the "Breaking News" radio broadcast on your Pip-Boy radio. The quest pops up on its own when you log in while The Slasher is on.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Mask-Guide/start-breaking-news-radio.avif}

sections.title: The Slasher: Masked Truth Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Find the masks

After the broadcast, the objective is Find Pint-Sized Slasher Masks in cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds. You need 10 for the quest. There's no one to hand them in to: the quest counts them as you pick them up.

When you pick up your first mask you also get Broadcast Recording: Breaking News, a holotape of the broadcast so you can play it again.

Step 2 – Collect the clippings

Some masks have a newspaper clipping inside. They pop up on their own as you go, so there's nothing extra to find: see Collecting the Masks below for which mask gives which.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/article-clipping-1-note.avif}

Step 3 – Read the torn page

Your 10th mask gives you A page torn from a children's book. Read it: it's a children's poem about the Pint-Sized Slasher, with directions written underneath.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/a-page-torn-from-a-children-s-book-note.avif,/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/a-page-torn-from-a-children-s-book-location.avif}

Step 4 – Follow the directions

The objective is now Investigate the area described in the note, with the hint "By the dog kennel, he smells your fear". What you find there is in The Finale below (spoilers).

Optional: the quest also asks you to tune in to The Debunker radio station for more news reports.

sections.title: Quest Rewards
sections.html:
• Finishing The Slasher: Masked Truth pays 300 caps, XP, Plan: Pint-Sized Phantom Outfit and a loot roll.
  • Each mask you pick up is worth a base of 400 XP.
  • The lifetime challenges for collecting masks pay out at 3, 10, 30 and 50 masks. There is no reward for collecting all 108.

Every reward is on The Slasher Guide.

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Do I have to find all 108 masks?

No. The quest only needs 10. The lifetime challenges stop at 50, and there is no reward for collecting all 108.

Can I do this after The Slasher ends?

No. The Slasher: Masked Truth is only available for the duration of The Slasher Seasonal Content.

Can I give spare masks to a friend?

No. Masks can't be dropped, traded or sold.

sections.title: The Finale
sections.html:
The directions under the poem read "Amid the ruins of suburbia, by road 85. Look for him." Head there and search the dog kennel the quest marks.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/we-re-coming-for-you-map.avif,/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/we-re-coming-for-you-location.avif}

By the kennel the killers have left a bloody mess, and in it the note We're Coming For You. Pick it up and The Slasher: Masked Truth is done.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/we-re-coming-for-you-note.avif}

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
The Breaking News broadcast comes from Remington Goodwin of The Debunker news radio station. He reports corpses displayed all over Appalachia, and a violent group paying homage to the serial killer known as the Pint-Sized Slasher.

The note at the kennel is signed by the Pint-Sized Phantoms, who say they bargain with death on his behalf, and promise more "gifts".

Every broadcast, clipping and note from this quest, with the full text: The Slasher Lore Checklist.
